dog.description_text:
Meet Dimitri!

Dimitri is sweet boy with a curious mind and a playful spirit! He likes to observe his surroundings and see what's going on before jumping into the fun. He's a little guy who loves taking it all in and figuring things out!

Once something catches his eye, Dimitri is ready for playtime! He especially enjoys chasing lasers and batting at wand toys. He's also a big fan of yummy treats, which are always a welcome bonus!

If you're looking for a curious young companion who enjoys watching the world, playing with toys, and snacking on tasty treats, Dimitri is ready to meet you!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
